question: Render 1: a=1, b="x". Render 2: a=1, b="y". Does the Effect re-run after render 2?
options: No, because a is the same
say: Render one has a one and b x. Render two has a one and b y. Does the Effect re-run after render two?
explanation: React skips only if all dependencies are the same. b changed from "x" to "y", so the Effect runs again.
explainSay: Yes. React only skips when every dependency is the same, and b changed.
